fields.description: Drive technology inside the enclosure (HDD, SSD)

guidance: External drives use a 2.5" (usually bus-powered) or 3.5" (with power adapter) mechanism, but the total dimensions depend on the enclosure. Only fill Länge_mm/Breite_mm/Höhe_mm when the sources state the enclosure's dimensions; do not derive them from the bare-drive form factor.
